claim: The six-scenario LEAN historical-simulation replay ran twice (independent fresh processes) on lean-985ef30-r20260925 after round 1 resolved the dotnet build blocker (see lean.json). Every economic/behavioral field this track was asked to compare -- native_end_equity_usd, fees, dividends, fill/margin-call counts, and max_observed_drawdown to full decimal precision, plus the full order/intent/margin-call/audit ledgers -- matched the frozen 2026-09-19 oracle exactly, for both runs. ROUND 3 CORRECTION: comparing against the ORACLE's own retained files (not run-vs-run) finds a 4th category the above omitted -- serverStatistics.'Up Time', which differs from the oracle in all 12 non-matching files (both runs use fresh, sub-second process lifetimes that do not equal the oracle's own Up Time value) even though it does NOT differ between run-1 and run-2 themselves (both runs' Up Time values agree with each other, which is why the run-vs-run diff above correctly does not list it).
